I have taken the official training courses by CompTIA for Network+, A+ Core 1 and Core 2, and Pentest+.

I have also taken the Official Cisco Training Courses for CCNA.

Some of my most recent experience is AI in regards to Setup, Training, and Efficiency.

I also have been working on my own Home Lab, which is currently running a Raspberry Pi 4b with ParrotOS which I can connect to remotely from anywhere on either my phone or my laptop.
